Subject: Re: Intro — security intake and questionnaire kickoff (notes + next steps)

Hi Ava / Samir —

Great meeting today — notes and concrete next steps below. Thanks for walking through the prefill.

Meeting notes (summary):
- Scope agreed: complete CAIQ baseline first; perform SIG deep-dive for infra/audit items flagged by Bridgecrest (approx. 20 Qs).
- Redwood SOC 2 status: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2026-08-31). We can provide the report under NDA.
- Data residency: Redwood supports region pinning for inference (US-only) for dedicated and private deployments. Hosted API customers default to multi-region—we can implement regional routing for Bridgecrest under Dedicated or Private options; details to confirm with Solutions team.
- Logs: Redwood retained request/response and audit logs for 90 days by default; longer retention is available on Dedicated with archive options. Sample log bundle will include: auth events, inference request/response (redacted), and control-plane audit entries.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Michael: upload signed NDA template and SOC 2 access instructions to shared Drive, and mark relevant CAIQ entries with evidence links (by 2026-12-06).
- Grace: prepare sample log bundle (redacted) and README; deliver by 2026-12-07. Attachment will be a small tarball with examples.
- Irene: map Bridgecrest prefilled CAIQ rows to Redwood evidence artifacts and flag any gaps; initial pass by 2026-12-06.
- Ava / Bridgecrest: confirm whether they need an on-prem/offline package (Private) or Dedicated-only commitment for region pinning by 2026-12-08.

Attachments delivered: redwood_caiaq_intake_v1.xlsx, logs_sample_readme.txt (placeholders; final artifacts to follow).

Next touchpoints:
- Evidence handoff call (if needed) week of 12/7 — tentative.
- DocuSign link for NDA and SOC 2 access (I will send once Bridgecrest confirms).

If anything missed, flag back and I'll update.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
